description: Modified IEEE 33-Bus Distribution Network Dataset with Hourly Energy Community Demand and Distributed Energy Resources is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marcos Tostado-Véliz (Universidad de Jaén). This dataset provides the input data used for the case study of a modified IEEE 33-bus radial distribution network with energy communities and distributed energy resources. The network comprises 33 buses and 32 branches, with bus 1 acting as the slack bus and buses 2–33 representing 32 energy communities. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
